rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Production Docker management system that exposes 23 MCP tools for comprehensive server administration. Covers app lifecycle management with Docker Compose and systemd orchestration, nginx reverse proxy configuration, age-encrypted secrets vault with tmpfs decryption, Git and GitHub workflow automation including repo onboarding and branch protection, and health monitoring with Telegram alerting. Includes a companion Go-based Telegram bot for remote server management through Claude Code sessions.
